pages.text: Messages | United Nations Skip to main content @UNICEF/Apochi Owoicho 2026 Messages Secretary-General UN-Water SG's Special Envoy on Water World Health Organization Secretary-General's message For women and girls, a safe toilet can mean the difference between danger and safety, stigma and dignity, illness and health. Clean, lockable and reliable sanitation services – alongside safe water and hygiene facilities – are a source of protection and empowerment. But across continents, unsafe or absent toilet facilities expose hundreds of millions of women and girls to risks ranging from loss of privacy to assault. They can even discourage women from eating and drinking throughout the day and make menstruation harder to manage. These challenges restrict women and girls’ participation in public life, from schools and workplaces to civic spaces. That is why a community without effective sanitation can never achieve gender equality. Women, girls and other vulnerable groups must be able to participate in shaping solutions and managing services that meet everyone’s needs. This World Toilet Day, let us redouble our efforts to ensure toilets are accessible and safe, and accelerate progress towards a more equal future for all. pages.description:
The new Metadata Manager tool (previously known as the record registration form) can be used to deposit metadata for your records. You do not need any knowledge of XML to use it.
How to use the new Metadata Manager 

 
Start at the landing page and sign in using your Crossref account credentials. You can choose to register a new record or edit an existing record. If you want to register a new journal article, book, report, dissertation, grant, or post-publication update, choose New Record.

pages.title: Metadata matching - Crossref
pages.description: Crossref enriches metadata to highlight relationships among works, individuals, institutions, and actions. Metadata matching is the task of finding an identifier for an item based on a structured or unstructured “description” of it. It’s a key part to our enrichment process and one way to address gaps in the scholarly record, while keeping barriers to membership and participation as low as possible – to enable inclusivity of the research nexus.

While our reactor has undergone an extended maintenance and recovery period, the metrics of the last five years reveal a facility that is far from idle. Instead, they tell a story of strategic investment, scientific resilience, and an unwavering commitment to the U.S. research community. Why Our Metrics Matter Today Scientific Continuity: Despite restricted reactor operations, our community has consistently produced over 200–300 publications annually. This output is driven by the active collaboration of NCNR scientists, who continue to support data analysis and modeling for researchers nationwide through the use of other facilities, leveraging legacy data, and partnerships with other agencies. Modernizing for a 10x Leap: We are leveraging this period to upgrade 3 beamlines, build a new neutron spectrometer, upgrade 11 other instruments, and enhance multiple sample environments. As devices become more complex, smaller, and multi-layered, the ability to measure, monitor, predict, and ensure quality in manufacturing becomes much more difficult and uncertain. Today, the domestic semiconductor industry faces some of these metrology challenges with workarounds and inadequate tools, limiting production yields, impacting quality, and increasing costs. As greater demands are put on semiconductor device performance and material requirements, these challenges will continue to intensify. The CHIPS Metrology Program emphasizes measurements that are accurate, precise, and fit-for-purpose for the production of microelectronic materials, devices, circuits, and systems. This work leverages NIST’s proven measurement science expertise, foundational communications and computing research capabilities, standards development contributions, and stakeholder engagement practices to address the highest priority metrology challenges identified across industry, academia, and government agencies. Metrology is the science of measurement and its application. NIST's work in metrology focuses on advancing measurement science to enhance economic security and improve quality of life. Eder Marcos Camacho Gomez/Getty Images Pan de muerto is an orange-scented sweet bread traditionally prepared and eaten during Día de los Muertos , a Mexican holiday celebrated each year from October 31 to November 2. Eder Marcos Camacho Gomez/Getty Images It’s autumn in Mexico City, and baker Elena Reygadas and her team at Panadería Rosetta are hard at work in the kitchen. Deftly, they shape mounds of soft, elastic dough into perfect rounds. Then, with two fingers, they gingerly form the huesitos , or little bones, laying the thin strips in a cross over the buns. A tray full of rolls slides into the bakery rack, resting alongside dozens of other matching loaves waiting for their turn in the oven. The bakers are making pan de muerto , an orange-scented sweet bread traditionally prepared and eaten during Día de los Muertos , Day of the Dead, a Mexican holiday celebrated each year from October 31 to November 2. For three days, legend decrees, the border between the mortal and spirit realms disappears.

It is now permanently closed . For the first time, MI5’s history was on display to the public, made possible through an unprecedented partnership between the Security Service and The National Archives. Visitors explored the ever-changing world of espionage and security threats through original case files, photographs and papers, alongside the real equipment used by spies and spy-catchers over MI5’s 115-year history. Ciamarra heads the Office of Policy and Rulemaking (APL) where he will advise the Administrator on major policy questions, lead the development of the FAA’s policy agenda, lead rulemaking and deregulatory efforts, and oversee the FAA’s implementation of congressional reauthorization. APL drives the agency’s strategic planning and national aviation policy – including environmental and energy strategy, aviation activity forecasts, and economic analyses. Ciamarra came to the FAA from Southwest Airlines where he was Senior Federal Affairs Director. There he developed the federal legislative and regulatory strategy for the company on issues such as air traffic control, airport development, and transportation security. pages.text: Michael Harris II wins 2022 NL Rookie of Year; Spencer Strider runner-up Skip to Content ATLANTA -- As Michael Harris II and Spencer Strider shared adjoining lockers within Truist Park’s home clubhouse this year, they fed off each other’s youthful excitement and established themselves as two of the most impressive rookies baseball has seen in years. When this past season ended, it was presumed these two Braves would finish first and second in balloting for the Jackie Robinson National League Rookie of the Year Award. The only question was who would win. The answer was revealed on Monday night, when Harris was announced as the recipient of this year’s honor. • Rookie of the Year Award, all-time winners Harris is the ninth Braves player to be named NL Rookie of the Year and the first since Ronald Acuña Jr. in 2018. This was an honor the 21-year-old center fielder certainly didn’t anticipate when he began this season with Double-A Mississippi. Harris received 22 of the 30 first-place votes cast by members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America, and Strider received the remaining eight. This is the first time teammates have finished first and second in Rookie of the Year balloting since former Braves Craig Kimbrel and Freddie Freeman in 2011. • Full voting results “To get the award [that is named after] Jackie, it means a lot because he paved the way for players like me,” Harris said. “Just to be able to have an award named after him and actually win it … I don’t know. Michael Helmer Michael Helmer brings nearly a decade of Capitol Hill experience to his role as Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary for the U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI). Most recently, Helmer served as legislative assistant to Senator Kevin Cramer of North Dakota, where he advised the Senator on energy, environmental, and trade issues. Helmer previously served at the U.S. Department of Energy from 2019 to 2021 in the Office of Congressional and Intergovernmental Affairs. Close michaelIsADullGuy's Diary 南京新街口地块精细化更新日志 Posted by michaelIsADullGuy on 29 May 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . 前言 新街口作为南京乃至华东地区最重要的商业核心之一，其 OSM 数据长期存在建筑轮廓粗糙、地下空间缺失、路径拓扑混乱等问题。为此，我启动了一项针对新街口地块的系统性精细化更新计划，并在此记录操作步骤与我所制定的制图标准，供社区参考与讨论。 一、建筑物轮廓与属性细化 所有建筑物的轮廓均参照最新卫星影像与实地核查进行重新描绘或修正，具体标准如下： 轮廓贴合建筑基底，避免过度简化或偏移； 补充 building:levels 、 height 、 name 、 start_date 等属性； 对于综合体建筑（如德基广场、金鹰国际），区分裙楼与塔楼，分别以 building 、 building:part 进行三维建模。 二、地下商业空间的划定 新街口地铁站（地铁1号线×2号线换乘）向四周延伸出大量地下通道，直接连通周边各大商场的负一层。凡与地铁站地下通道 直接联通 的商场负一层空间，均按以下标准标注为地下建筑区域： 使用 location=underground 或 layer=-1 标记相关区域； 地下商业区域的范围多边形参照实际通道出入口与商业空间边界绘制； 与地铁站直接相连的通道本身，以 tunnel=yes + layer=-1 的 highway=footway 表示； 暂不确定是否联通的区域，暂以 fixme=需核实地下联通情况 标注，留待后续实地核查。 目前已完成地下空间划定的区域包括： 新街口百货商店 B1、金陵中环 B1 待补充区域： 金鹰国际购物中心 B1、德基广场 B1、中央商场 B1、南京国际金融中心 B1 等。 三、路径拓扑标准 这是本次更新中最容易出错的部分。为确保路网拓扑的清洁与导航规划的准确性，我制定了以下强制性规则： 3.1 各类道路不得混接 在主要路口， 行人路径（ highway=footway/pedestrian ）、自行车道（ highway=cycleway ）、机动车道（ highway=primary 等） 三者之间，原则上不建议建立直接连接节点，除非现实中存在明确的路权交汇点（如行人过街横道节点）。 3.2 跨图层要素禁止连接 任何两个 不属于同一 layer 值 的路径要素， 不得出现共享连接节点 ，以下情况除外： 允许连接的要素 说明 highway=steps 阶梯，连接不同楼层/层级 含 conveying=yes 的 highway=footway 自动扶梯 highway=elevator 电梯 除上述垂直交通要素外，地面路径与地下路径 一律不得出现连接点 。 此规则同样适用于在导航计算中看似”无害”的连接（例如建筑物轮廓与步行道路相切）。只要两个要素不属于同一图层，路径要素与非路径要素之间同样须保持几何上的独立性，仅在视觉上相邻即可。同一图层内的要素按正常规则连接，不受此限制。 如有异议或建议，欢迎在变更集评论或讨论页留言。 Happy mapping! 🗺️ Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

Hero of the High Renaissance . He was the only artist of whom it was claimed in his lifetime that he surpassed Antiquity . He was born in Caprese in the 1470s and trained first as a painter with Ghirlandaio , and then as a sculptor under the patronage of Lorenzo de' Medici . In 1496, already known as sculptor, he went to Rome, where he carved the 'Pietà' for St Peter's. Back in Florence in 1501 he began work on many sculptural and painterly projects most of which were left unfinished in 1505, when he was summoned to Rome to begin work on a sculpted tomb for Pope Julius II, a project that dogged him until 1545. From 1508 to 1512 he painted the vault of the Sistine Chapel with scenes from the Old Testament, from the Creation to the Story of Noah. Immediately celebrated, the Sistine Chapel ceiling, with its innumerable figures in complex, twisting poses and its exuberant use of colour, is the chief source of the Mannerist style. pages.description: While restoring the Sistine Chapel, researchers discovered wavy groupings of brushstrokes which indicated that the artist used the special brushes to create a distinct crosshatching pattern
pages.text: Michelangelo Used These Custom, Multi-Headed Brushes While Painting 'The Last Judgment' to Replicate His Intricate Sculpting Techniques Skip to main content Detail showing the hair of one of the figures around Christ in The Last Judgment , as example of the use of a multi-tipped brush Governatorato SCV – Direzione dei Musei e dei Beni Culturali This spring, the Vatican restored the Sistine Chapel for the first time in 30 years. Restorers worked for three months to remove layers of calcium lactate—a whitish salt from the dried sweat from millions of visitors and the plaster in the walls—that had settled onto Michelangelo ’s immaculate 16th-century murals. As experts climbed temporary scaffolding and applied distilled water and absorbent Japanese paper to clean away the grime, they got a rare, close-up view of Michelangelo’s vivid masterpieces. They noticed something unique about The Last Judgment , the massive mural located behind the chapel’s altar, as its original colors emerged. Michelangelo had painted with wavy brushstrokes that appeared to have moved in synchronization. “I initially saw that Michelangelo painted with parallel strokes, often perpendicular to each to give a cross-hatching effect,” Paolo Violini , the Vatican’s chief restorer, tells the London Times ’ Tom Kington. “Then I saw that when a stroke wobbled slightly, other strokes parallel to it had an identical wobble. That meant one thing: Michelangelo was using special brushes with multiple heads, each with a small brush on the end of it, allowing him to produce parallel strokes with one large brush.” Examp

Saint John the Evangelist may be the figure on the left carrying Christ’s body on strips of winding cloth helped by one of the Three Marys. They carry him up a staircase to his tomb in the rocks. The man behind Christ is either Joseph of Arimathea or Nicodemus. Another of the Three Marys, possibly Mary Magdalene, sits on the ground. The space left empty on the right was probably intended for the kneeling figure of the Virgin Mary. The other female figure on the right is probably another of the Three Marys, Mary Salome. The microloan program provides loans up to $50,000 to help small businesses and certain not-for-profit childcare centers start up and expand. The average microloan is about $13,000. SBA provides funds to specially designated intermediary lenders, which are nonprofit community-based organizations with experience in lending as well as management and technical assistance. These intermediaries administer the Microloan program for eligible borrowers. Am I eligible? To be eligible for a microloan, businesses must: Not be a type of ineligible business Be an operating business Operate for profit Be located in the U.S. Be small under SBA size requirements How do I use a microloan? Microloans can be used for a variety of purposes that help small businesses expand. Use them when you need less than $50,000 to start and/or grow your small business.
